entries.40237ebe359e444a: This business delivers machine tools, cutting tools and other products to manufacturing sites. entries.5ff9400ed9e250c1: This business division sells machine tools (machining centers, CNC lathes, CNC grinders, CNC milling machines, electrical discharge machines, general-purpose machine tools, 3D printers, etc.), forging and sheet-metal machinery (presses, shearing machines, bending machines, laser cutting machines), injection molding machines, die-casting machines, CAD/CAM, and machine tool peripherals (industrial robots, measuring instruments, automation peripherals, etc.), among other products. The MD&A states that, for machine tools, sales to automotive parts processing manufacturers were slightly below the previous year. On the other hand, it worked on approaches to industries such as shipbuilding, aviation and defense, and on proposal-based sales aimed at mid-sized and small and medium-sized enterprises using large-scale growth investment subsidies and other programs, and it states that in the fourth quarter it captured demand from parts manufacturers of semiconductor equipment, where recovery was clear, and that orders were strong. entries.6248e4aa29d28cd0: This business plans, develops and sells home appliances, interior furniture, outdoor and leisure goods, and kitchen and daily necessities, and is handled by the Household Appliances Division. The annual securities report positions it, together with the Housing and Construction Business, as a consumer goods-related business (a business field that proposes “creating comfortable living spaces” through the supply of housing equipment, home-life products and other items). In the fiscal year ended March 2026, external customer sales were ¥101,560 million (up 0.7% year on year), and segment profit was ¥4,810 million (¥4,449 million in the fiscal year ended March 2025). The MD&A states that it expanded private brand products through quick planning and development based on marketing activities that analyzed customer feedback, and that it aims to spread the YAMAZEN brand through information dissemination using SNS and other channels. Revenue increased, reflecting strong sales of fan-equipped wear and portable air conditioners during the intense heat of last summer, along with growth in EC. Sales and membership numbers also grew at the company’s own EC site for corporations and sole proprietors, “Yamazen Bizukomu.” The capital expenditure overview states that the company newly established “Rojisu EC Kantō,” an EC-dedicated base for the Household Appliances Business, which began operating in April 2026.

entries.6e94e6835c175fcf: This category is listed as the 2nd of the production goods-related businesses in the "Description of Business" of the securities report, and is handled by the Overseas Division. It is stated to carry out the import and export of machine tools, injection molding machines, electronics and semiconductor equipment, machine tool peripherals, cutting tools, measuring instruments, component parts, robots and automation equipment, environmental equipment and more, support for the overseas relocation of overseas procurement and production plants, trilateral trade, total planning of factory production equipment and systems, and the procurement and sale of product materials. The company history states that this Overseas Division was established in April 2025 by reclassifying the domestic and overseas categories. The MD&A states that in the fiscal year ended March 2026, although performance fluctuated by branch up to the 3rd quarter, all branches exceeded the previous year's results for the full year. It states that the North America branch captured demand related to the aerospace industry, power generation and data centers, the Taiwan branch captured demand related to AI and semiconductors, and the ASEAN branch captured demand for production transfers from other countries in addition to domestic demand. It also states that, toward "accelerating global expansion," it acquired all shares of AtoG1 Co., Ltd., the parent company of a machine tool trading company in Malaysia, in February 2026, and all shares of PT. Somagede Indonesia, a machinery and tool trading company in Indonesia, in March, making both companies subsidiaries. Net sales of this category alone are not printed in the securities report.

entries.e9acb46d245482bb: This business sells housing equipment such as kitchen equipment, bathroom equipment, washstand equipment, water heaters, sanitary equipment, and air-conditioning and ventilation-related equipment, as well as building materials such as interior and exterior building materials and sashes, and also carries out related construction work and services; it is handled by the Housing and Construction Division. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, external customer sales were ¥87,403 million (up 11.2% year on year), and segment profit was ¥3,662 million (¥3,192 million in the fiscal year ended March 2025). The MD&A states that, in addition to strong sales of air-conditioning equipment driven by demand from extreme heat and energy-saving renovations, sales of water heaters and other equipment also grew, as the company focused on proposing high value-added products that match consumers’ thrift-minded preferences amid persistently high utility costs.
